[worker workerB r2] {"commands": ["find /app -name 'gen_init_cpio' 2>/dev/null | head -20; ls -la /app/linux-6.9/usr/ 2>/dev/null; find /app -path '*/usr/gen_init_cpio' 2>/dev/null; tmux wait -S done", "cat /app/linux-6.9/init/main.c 2>/dev/null | grep -A 5 'asmlinkage __visible void __init start_kernel'; tmux wait -S
PLAN: cd /app/fsspec && grep -n "class AbstractAsyncFileSystem" asyn.py && grep -n "def open" asyn.py && grep -n "class DirFileSystem" dirfs.py
